description: Puts a thread the filter or someone else filed as spam back into the Inbox of its mailbox, and unblocks its sender. A thread that is not in Spam is left where it is, and nothing is unblocked. To take several threads out of Spam, give conversation_id the list of their ids, in ONE call rather than one call per thread: the answer then lists in "results" the outcome of each thread in the order given ("ok", with its "result" or its "error") and counts "succeeded" and "failed". Each thread passes exactly the checks it would alone, so one refused or out of reach ("not found") leaves the others done, and the call is an error only when none succeeded.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it, or a list of up to 50 ids to do the same to every one of them in a single call.

name: mark_not_spam
title: Take a thread out of spam
